Three consecutive doubles at the 3rd, 4th and 5th removed six shots from his card before anyone had settled.

findings.excerpt: Jon Baker came to Royal Cinque Ports for his second visit holding the best round this field has ever played there, an 85 in the TEG 13 Trophy.
He shot 92, handing back seven shots on his own high-water mark.
A double bogey at the 2nd.
A triple at the par-5 3rd.
A bogey at the short 4th, one of the easiest holes on the course.
Then a triple at the 5th and a bogey at the 6th.
Then a triple at the 5th and a bogey at the 6th.
Three straight pars from the 11th brought him nine Stableford points and the brief look of a man who remembered how this worked.
Baker ended round one last in the Trophy standings, and bottom of the Spoon race as well.
